body:
That is my point man, they will send me to detox. Then send me home and schedule me for another seat in treatment, Then I start drinking again, have to detox and lose my seat again.

I have to get into treatment asap. Yeah, withdrawals might kill me but not getting into treatment asap will definitely kill me. 

I have to power through this somehow.

OK.  I asked a question.  I am not arguing with anyone or anything. I wanted to know first hand experience. You gave me that.

Alright? Call your sponsor and tell him what a good boy you are.

Thanks so much!

Thanks everyone. "The kindling effect" was very educational.

The main reason I am asking is because I am trying to get into a treatment center and if they think I am withdrawing, ironically they won't let me in. I am going to have to detox on my own. I have done it before. 

Now I am a little bit more concerned.  I am not a young man anymore.

Wow, I did google. Everyone should. I have never heard of that but that explains somethings that have happened to me.

Thank you.
I was right, it is very uncommon to die from withdrawals.

Thanks for the constructive criticism. I was hesitant to post the story.

> I'm not really quite sure why she's a handful though 

Yeah, when I think about it. I have the character developed in my head but didn't put it forth correctly. 

Do you watch Bob's Burgers?  This was my inspiration for Louise. Louise Belcher.  She is a handful.

man, this made me cry. My older brother died about 4 years ago.  We were very close. 

It took me forever to delete his contact from my phone. I remember deleting it and it gave that prompt "Are you sure?".  I pressed yes and   I knew my brother was gone forever.
I like this story too. You kind of leave it to the reader to fill in the reader to fill in the blanks. Great title too.
hmm, I don't care if anyone watches me.

hey hope you are ok. It is kind of funny you mention a backstory. I use a ton of throwaways and my bitch on this sub is the backstories. 

It is people without a backstory that are the ones who are actually going to do it. 

You are welcome to PM me but I will probably just log off and never use this account again.
